title: Spicy Sausage Skewers with Saudi Arabian Zesty Sauce
description: A fusion of Thai and Saudi Arabian flavors, these spicy sausage skewers are served with a zesty sauce for a delicious and aromatic meal.

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak in water for 30 minutes before use

ingredients.name: Zesty Herb
ingredients.notes: Chopped, from Saudi Arabian Zesty Sauce

instructions: Soak skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Thread sausage onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Meanwhile, mix Saudi Arabian Zesty Sauce with minced garlic, grated ginger, fish sauce, and soy sauce (if using).
Brush sauce onto skewers during last minute of grilling.
Serve skewers hot with additional Saudi Arabian Zesty Sauce for dipping.
